lines.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, writes to the saints in Corinth.
God blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing and chose us before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless.
In love God predestined us for adoption as His sons through Jesus Christ, to the praise of His glorious grace.
In Christ we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, and God purposed a plan to bring all things together in Christ.
Those who heard and believed the gospel were sealed with the Holy Spirit, who is the pledge of our wages.
